input_layout.scope: Authored default layout in fresh context; local layout identity retained. No runtime input-profile mutation.

canvas_before.gpu_time_scope: Not measured; FPS is not GPU time.

input_error: RuntimeError: Input window overran; remaining gestures not dispatched

browser.scope: RAF closure requested after the observation window and resolved by this observer only after recording a RAF timestamp at or after that request. Already-queued stale RAF timestamps do not close the window. Wall time, RAF-covered span and boundary gaps are separate. LongTasks are browser main-thread tasks, not GPU time.

rate_formulas.observed_window_fps: RAF callbacks observed / full actual wall capture duration; callback throughput, not proof of GPU presentation
rate_formulas.completed_interval_fps: complete consecutive RAF intervals / their covered RAF timestamp span; must be read with coverage and uncovered boundary gaps

native.scope: Instrumented real demo; inclusive nested script costs, no summed total or phone/GPU attribution. Per-frame counter reads/delta dictionaries add observer work; no image/audio readback in capture.

native_summary.scope: Godot monitors and instrumented inclusive wrappers; nested costs must not be added. Native capture is a separately timestamped subset of the encompassing browser window.
native_summary.cue_scope: Original GameAudio accepted playback counters, including selected workshop keys; not browser audible-output proof or one-to-one proof of every requested action.

comparison_boundary.scope: Retain actual min health and min/max Y. Health loss flags damage/possible fall and invalidates the controlled entry comparison; Y alone does not prove a fall. Initial/final context and manifest are checked separately.

canvas_after.gpu_time_scope: Not measured; FPS is not GPU time.

action_frame_distribution.scope: Complete raw RAF intervals intersecting first-through-last actual touch delivery, including boundary-crossing stalls. Distribution only; no partial-window FPS denominator.

input_boundary.scope: All planned touch delivery must finish before27s after capture request; native starts after request and runs30s. Late/incomplete input invalidates the comparison; no truncated window acceptance.

failure.message: Input window overran; remaining gestures not dispatched
